title: OperatorReconcileLineageV1
$comment: Story 4.16a (AC9) — the stable wire shape for `deliveryline operator reconcile-lineage {artifactId} --format json`. Additive fields are allowed within v1; any removal/rename bumps to v2. lineageReferenceArtifactId is the chosen new parent (reattach_to_existing_lineage) or the newly created fork head (create_explicit_fork), null for terminate_ambiguous_lineage. reconciledEventId/correlationId are null-tolerant; replayed is true on an idempotent replay.
